step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify nodes from visual elements and audio description:
   - Data sources: EFS (0), DynamoDB (1), RedShift (2), S3 Source (3).
   - ETL process: Glue (4).
   - Central Data Store: S3 Central (5).
   - Compute & Orchestration: Lambda (6).
   - Machine Learning: SageMaker (7).
   - Endpoints / Consumption: API Gateway (8), QuickSight / BI (9).
2. Trace connections:
   - Data sources feed into Glue for ETL processing (Flow 0).
   - Glue transforms and writes data into S3 Central (Flow 0).
   - S3 data load events trigger Lambda ('CLUSTER', Flow 1).
   - Lambda invokes SageMaker ('PREDICT', Flow 1).
   - SageMaker writes the 'NEXT BEST OFFER' output back to S3 Central (Flow 1).
   - SageMaker serves data out to API Gateway for real-time applications and QuickSight (BI) for business dashboards (Flow 2).
3. Assign flow IDs, sequences, and valid service types adhering strictly to schema rules.

graph.name: TASOLS Event-Driven Machine Learning Architecture
graph.notes: Serverless event-driven architecture that chains machine learning models (clustering and prediction) using AWS Glue, Lambda, SageMaker, and S3, exposing results via API Gateway and QuickSight BI dashboards.

nodes.name: EFS
nodes.notes: Data source for flat files and shared files.

nodes.name: REDSHIFT
nodes.notes: Structured columnar data warehouse data source.

nodes.name: S3 Source
nodes.notes: S3 bucket serving as an initial landing area for flat files.

nodes.name: GLUE
nodes.notes: Performs ETL transformations on data from various source databases and file stores.

nodes.name: S3 Central
nodes.notes: Central data lake repository where transformed data and final model outputs (Next Best Offer) are stored.

nodes.name: LAMBDA
nodes.notes: Serverless function triggered by S3 data load events to orchestrate SageMaker processing.

nodes.name: SAGEMAKER
nodes.notes: Runs layered ML algorithms: K-Means clustering followed by Random Forest prediction models.

nodes.name: API
nodes.notes: API interface for real-time consumption by call center agents, websites, and external applications.

nodes.name: BI
nodes.notes: Business intelligence dashboard for management visibility and historical insight analysis.
